help.title: Help Center
help.description: Help for bookings, payments and cancellations.

hotels.q: Can I cancel my hotel booking for a refund?
hotels.a: Each rate plan has its own free-cancellation deadline. Free-cancellation rates refund in full with no penalty when cancelled before the deadline on the voucher (usually 24-72 hours before check-in). Non-refundable deals charge a 100% cancellation fee.
No. Listed rates are tax-exclusive references, and the final amount including 10% tax is confirmed on the pre-payment review screen.

hotels.q: Where can I find my booking voucher?
hotels.a: After the supplier confirms your booking, you can view and print the voucher from your booking details. No voucher is issued before confirmation.

flights.q: Can I cancel my flight ticket for a refund?
flights.a: Cancellations before midnight on the ticketing day are fully refundable with no airline fee (some promo fares excluded). After ticketing, the airline's fare-rule penalty is deducted.

flights.q: When do I get my e-ticket and booking reference (PNR)?
flights.a: Ticketing proceeds after payment once the supplier confirms, and you can find the PNR and e-ticket number in your booking details after ticketing is complete.

flights.q: How can I pay for flights?
flights.a: You can pay by credit or debit card, and all payments are processed in KRW.

trains.q: Can I cancel train tickets online?
trains.a: Yes. If you request cancellation from your bookings, the fee and refund are calculated under that booking's cancellation policy, and you can review the amounts before confirming.

trains.q: How can I pay for train tickets?
trains.a: You can pay by credit or debit card, and all payments are processed in KRW.

trains.q: Where can I find my train ticket?
trains.a: After the supplier confirms your booking, you can check the confirmation in your booking details.

cars.q: Can I cancel my rental car for a refund?
cars.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 24-48 hours before pickup, while no-shows are non-refundable.

cars.q: How can I pay for rental cars?
cars.a: You can pay by credit or debit card, and all payments are processed in KRW.

cars.q: Where can I find my rental confirmation?
cars.a: After the supplier confirms your booking, you can view and print the voucher from your booking details.

transfers.q: Can I cancel my airport pickup for a refund?
transfers.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 24-48 hours before pickup, while no-shows are non-refundable.

transfers.q: How can I pay for airport pickups?
transfers.a: You can pay by credit or debit card, and all payments are processed in KRW.

transfers.q: Where can I find my pickup voucher?
transfers.a: After the supplier confirms your booking, you can view and print the voucher from your booking details.

todos.q: Can I cancel tours and tickets for a refund?
todos.a: Each product follows its own published cancellation policy: usually a full refund 3-7 days ahead and a partial refund 1-2 days ahead. E-tickets with an instantly issued QR code cannot be cancelled or exchanged after issuance.

todos.q: How are tour and ticket prices calculated?
todos.a: Prices are shown per person, and time-slot products apply separate adult and child fares.

todos.q: Where can I find my e-voucher?
todos.a: After the supplier confirms your booking, you can view and print the e-voucher from your booking details.

packages.q: Can I cancel my package for a refund?
packages.a: The fee and refund are calculated under your package booking's cancellation policy, and you can review the amounts on your bookings screen before confirming.
Package prices are shown per person and multiplied by the number of travelers you select.

packages.q: How can I pay for packages?
packages.a: You can pay by credit or debit card, and all payments are processed in KRW.

esim.q: Can I buy an eSIM now?
esim.a: No. Only plan browsing is available right now while sales are being prepared.

esim.q: How do I receive my eSIM QR code?
esim.a: Once sales open, the QR code will be sent to your booking confirmation email. The plans shown now cannot be purchased yet.

esim.q: How do I browse eSIM plans?
esim.a: Select a country to see the plans available for use in that country.

insurance.q: Can I buy travel insurance now?
insurance.a: No. Only coverage details and estimated premiums can be viewed right now while sales are being prepared.
Select your travel dates to see an estimate multiplying the daily premium by the number of days.
Medical, baggage, and cancellation coverage amounts differ by plan, so check the coverage amounts shown on the product screen.
